answers.text: I'm a final-year BTech student in computer science at a private engineering college in Coimbatore. My main project was a bus-pass renewal app for our college transport office. I now want an MBA because I enjoy deciding what to build more than writing the code, and I don't have the business training for that.

I would say my project was a very scalable and innovative solution that leveraged the latest technologies to create value for all stakeholders. It was a great learning experience and the impact was significant.
I don't remember the exact number of bugs we fixed after the pilot. I never kept a proper log, so I can't give a figure.
